outcome: Ganglion cell layer and inner plexiform layer (GCL + IPL) thickness
Peripapillary retinal nerve fiber layer thickness
cohort: Sixty healthy pregnant women (30 undergoing normal vaginal delivery and 30 undergoing cesarean section) were included.
finding: Normal vaginal delivery leads to early postpartum changes in choroidal vascular structure and optic disc morphology, while cesarean section primarily shows an increase in ganglion cell layer and inner plexiform layer thickness.
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery results in observable changes in the choroidal vascular structure and optic disc morphology in the early postpartum period, whereas cesarean section only shows an increase in GCL+IPL thickness.
